deadline.value: All PhD applications must be received by December 15, 2026.

also.quote: ALL PhD applications must be received by December 15 for consideration for the Fall cycle.

gre_general.value: GRE General scores are not required but can be submitted to show math proficiency.
gre_general.quote: GRE General Test scores are not required for MS/ME or PhD applicants but can demonstrate mathematics proficiency if submitted.

supervisor.value: You are admitted to the BME program, not to an individual lab; contacting faculty has little bearing on admission.
supervisor.quote: applicants are admitted to the Rutgers BME graduate program and not to individual faculty laboratories

funding.value: The program guarantees five years of support to PhD students who stay in good standing and full-time.
funding.quote: The Biomedical Engineering Graduate Program guarantees 5 years of support for PhD students who remain in good standing and in full-time status in the Program.

entry_route.value: You can enter the PhD directly without a master's, though entry criteria are stricter than for the master's.
entry_route.quote: Can I enter the PhD program directly without completing a Masters? | Yes, students must keep in mind that the entrance criteria into the PhD program are more stringent than that of the Master's program.
